userStories.title: Create ParlayGradingService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to calculate parlay outcomes based on leg results.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ParlayGradingService.swift in Booki/Services/
Create enum ParlayOutcome with cases: pending, win(payout: Decimal), loss, push, partiallyGraded(gradedCount: Int, totalCount: Int)
Add static function calculateParlayOutcome(bets: [Bet], policy: ParlayPushVoidPolicy) -> ParlayOutcome
If any leg has gradeResult == .loss, return .loss
If all legs have gradeResult == .win, calculate payout and return .win(payout:)
If any leg not yet graded (gradeResult == nil), return .partiallyGraded or .pending
Handle push/void legs based on policy parameter
Project builds and runs in Simulator

userStories.title: Implement American Odds Combination Math
userStories.description: As a developer, I need correct parlay payout calculation using American odds multiplication.
acceptanceCriteria: Add static function calculateParlayPayout(stake: Decimal, bets: [Bet], excludeVoidPush: Bool) -> Decimal to ParlayGradingService
Convert each leg's American odds to decimal: positive = 1 + odds/100, negative = 1 + 100/|odds|
Multiply all decimal odds together to get combined multiplier
Calculate payout: stake × combinedMultiplier - stake (profit only)
When excludeVoidPush=true, skip legs with gradeResult == .push or .void status
If no valid legs remain after exclusion, return 0 (stake returned separately)
Add helper function americanToDecimal(odds: Int) -> Decimal
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Math must match industry standard parlay calculations

userStories.title: Handle Voided Legs with Policy
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need voided legs to be handled according to the configured policy.
acceptanceCriteria: When grading a leg as void (bet.status = .void), check parlay policy
reduceLegReprice policy: recalculate payout excluding voided leg
If all non-void legs win, parlay wins at reduced odds
If only voided legs remain, treat as push (return stake)
treatAsPush policy: any voided leg makes entire parlay a push
